name: Living Away From Home Allowance (LAFHA) for apprentices
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: Weekly Commonwealth allowance for apprentices who move out of their parent's or guardian's home for the first time for their apprenticeship.
key: $125.52 a week in year one, $94.14 in year two and $47.07 in year three.
who: Apprentices who must move away from their parent's or guardian's home for the first time
Within 36 months of the apprenticeship start date (commencements from 1 January 2026)
Apprentices who are homeless may also be eligible
catches: Not payable to anyone getting Youth Allowance, Austudy, ABSTUDY, Centrelink rent assistance, or free or subsidised accommodation from their employer.
Weekly amounts are from the payments table in the overview.

source.label: DEWR: Australian Apprenticeships Incentive System payments overview

evidence.quote: Available to apprentices who need to move away from their parent's or guardian's home for the first time to:
Apprentice must be within 36 months of the commencement date of their apprenticeship.
